landing.title: Build plans for u60-monitor
landing.lede: u60-monitor is a lightweight Flutter app (Android + iOS) showing live cellular upload / download speed from a ZTE U60 Pro 5G modem — a thin client over the on-modem zte-agent. Each plan below is a sequence of disciplined TDD cycles. Pick a plan to read its cycles and parallel runbook.
